title: Integration tests and API contracts — Module Quiz
description: Course assessment: Catch API, database, and security regressions before release.
author: DailyCoder

questions.prompt: Which Spring test slice focuses on MVC controllers?
questions.explanation: WebMvcTest configures a focused web-layer test.

questions.prompt: Which slice focuses on JPA persistence?
What does Testcontainers commonly require locally?
Why test against PostgreSQL when production uses PostgreSQL?

options.text: To catch dialect, constraint, and transaction differences
To make tests always slower intentionally
Because in-memory Java objects cannot be tested

questions.explanation: Database-family compatibility matters beyond basic SQL syntax.

questions.prompt: Do service ownership assertions alone prove HTTP authorization is wired correctly?
questions.explanation: Endpoint tests must also verify the actual security and transport path.

questions.prompt: Which test setup removes reliance on the public internet?
questions.explanation: Controlled dependencies make success and failure deterministic.

options.text: A failing denial assertion should be ignored as a flaky test
Both ownership assertions pass; a regression allowing bob fails the test.
Both assertions prove every HTTP endpoint is secured automatically
The second assertion should allow bob

questions.explanation: Create an expense belonging to alice. Verify the owner path succeeds. Verify bob is denied; endpoint tests must separately verify the HTTP boundary.
